activity.notes: Theagenes was the archaic tyrant of Megara. His chronology depends on the disputed dating of Cylon's attempted coup; Oxford places the relevant window between roughly 640 and 620 BCE, while the Harvard Center for Hellenic Studies gives a broader tyranny window around 640/630–600 BCE. ATLAS therefore records c.630 BCE as a representative point rather than inventing a precise reign duration.

sources.citation_text: Oxford identifies Theagenes as tyrant of Megara and notes that the date of his tyranny depends on Cylon, placing it somewhere between about 640 and 620 BCE.
